q: Ammeter and voltmeter are devices for measuring current and ____ (voltage), respectively.
e: Ammeter and voltmeter are devices for measuring current and potential difference (voltage), respectively. Potential difference is what this statement is using.

q: They are constructed based on the principle of a ____.
e: Superposition: the resultant at a point is the sum of the individual displacements. They are constructed based on the principle of a moving coil galvanometer.

q: A moving coil galvanometer is an instrument which is used to ____.
e: A moving coil galvanometer is an instrument which is used to measure electric currents. Measure electric currents is what this statement is using.

q: It is a sensitive electromagnetic device which can measure low currents even of the order of a few ____.
e: A current makes a magnetic field. Soft iron in a solenoid is a temporary magnet; reverse the current and the poles flip. It is a sensitive electromagnetic device which can measure low currents even of the order of a few microamperes.

q: The coil is suspended in a ____ and is free to rotate about a fixed axis.
e: The coil is suspended in a uniform radial magnetic field and is free to rotate about a fixed axis. Uniform radial magnetic field is what this statement is using.

q: A cylindrical ____ is symmetrically positioned inside the coil to improve the strength of the magnetic field and to make the field radial.
e: A cylindrical soft iron core is symmetrically positioned inside the coil to improve the strength of the magnetic field and to make the field radial. Soft iron core is what this statement is using.

q: The spring is used to produce a ____ which balances the magnetic torque producing a steady angular deflection.
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. The spring is used to produce a counter torque which balances the magnetic torque producing a steady angular deflection.

q: The angle through which the coil is deflected due to the effect of the magnetic torque is ____ to the magnitude of current in the coil.
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. The angle through which the coil is deflected due to the effect of the magnetic torque is proportional to the magnitude of current in the coil.

q: A galvanometer is converted into an ammeter by connecting it in ____ with a wire of low resistance called shunt resistance.
e: Resistance is V/I. A larger resistance gives a smaller current for the same voltage. A galvanometer is converted into an ammeter by connecting it in parallel with a wire of low resistance called shunt resistance.

q: A galvanometer is converted into a voltmeter by connecting it in ____ with high resistance resistor (multiplier resistor).
e: Resistance is V/I. A larger resistance gives a smaller current for the same voltage. A galvanometer is converted into a voltmeter by connecting it in series with high resistance resistor (multiplier resistor).

q: The voltages across the galvanometer and shunt resistance are equal due to the ____ of their connection.
e: Resistance is V/I. A larger resistance gives a smaller current for the same voltage. The voltages across the galvanometer and shunt resistance are equal due to the parallel nature of their connection.

q: The relationship between the galvanometer current, shunt current, and their resistances is given by ____.
e: Resistance is V/I. A larger resistance gives a smaller current for the same voltage. The relationship between the galvanometer current, shunt current, and their resistances is given by iR = (I - i)r.

q: The total voltage drop across the voltmeter is given by the equation ____.
e: The total voltage drop across the voltmeter is given by the equation V = i(R + R_v). Leave the relation as V = i(R + R_v).
Ammeter is a low resistance device. Low resistance is what this statement is using.
Voltmeter is a high resistance device. High resistance is what this statement is using.

q: Ammeter is connected in ____ with circuit component.
e: Ammeter is connected in series with circuit component. Series is what this statement is using.

q: Voltmeter is connected in ____ with circuit component.
e: Voltmeter is connected in parallel with circuit component. Parallel is what this statement is using.
